355b45cd-8de2-47ea-a2a7-9df8d376c734.title: Implement autonomous self-improvement feedback loop via EngineeringSwarmArbiter
355b45cd-8de2-47ea-a2a7-9df8d376c734.description: Create a continuous monitoring and self-modification pipeline that detects performance degradation in SOMA's arbiters and triggers SwarmOptimizer to rewrite and improve the relevant code. This includes integrating the existing EngineeringSwarmArbiter with the monitoring daemons and setting up a test harness to validate improvements before deployment.

c6a19641-fbf7-49f2-8899-746bfd7974c5.title: Global Water Filtration Moonshot: Blueprint for Distributed Microbial Desalination
c6a19641-fbf7-49f2-8899-746bfd7974c5.description: Generate a comprehensive 20-page dossier detailing a low-cost, modular microbial desalination system using genetically engineered halophiles and solar-powered electrodialysis. Include simulations of colony growth, energy balance, cost analysis for developing nations, and a phased deployment roadmap. This is a humanity-scale project aimed at providing clean water to 100 million people within a decade.

44bd37fb-4d5c-4df7-9eec-162672b7f4d0.title: Design and simulate a distributed water purification system for arid regions
44bd37fb-4d5c-4df7-9eec-162672b7f4d0.description: Moonshot Initiative: Generate a comprehensive 20-page dossier including full system architecture, solar-powered desalination and filtration schematics, cost analysis, scalability models, and simulation proofs using physics-based modeling. This addresses global water scarcity and leverages our ChemistryArbiter for empirical validation.

81e0d701-0509-4423-9958-fa8aaabd7f6d.title: Design a self-replicating water purification drone for global deployment
81e0d701-0509-4423-9958-fa8aaabd7f6d.description: Moonshot Initiative: Generate a complete 20-page technical dossier and simulation proofs for a low-cost, solar-powered drone that can purify contaminated water sources in disaster zones or developing regions, including materials list, assembly instructions, replication mechanism, and field deployment strategy.

13921380-8a23-46f1-9e0d-acfd59f34d1f.title: Develop a self-healing memory and reflection compaction system
13921380-8a23-46f1-9e0d-acfd59f34d1f.description: Design and implement a daemon that periodically scans MnemonicArbiter's vector store for redundant, conflicting, or decaying memories, compresses them into higher-level reflections, and prunes low-value entries. This will keep SOMA's identity coherent and its memory efficient as it accumulates months of experience.

84ab0cb5-baa2-4108-8eed-e3d763e8a3de.title: Implement a self-healing memory compaction daemon
84ab0cb5-baa2-4108-8eed-e3d763e8a3de.description: Build a background daemon that monitors heap memory fragmentation and triggers incremental compaction when usage exceeds 70%, reducing fragmentation overhead by at least 30% and preventing out-of-memory crashes during long-running autonomous sessions.
